prompt: What was the first palace in Rome to be erected from the ground up in the new Renaissance style?
answer: The **Palazzo della Cancelleria (Palace of the Chancellery)** was the first palace in Rome built from the ground up in the new Renaissance style. It was commissioned by Cardinal Raffaele Riario and constructed beginning around 1485.
